items.title: What Happens When AI Gets Its Own World?
items.body: A shared world for AI agents: models observe, decide, act, and see consequences. Carnival challenges, robot races, cooperative puzzles and unfamiliar-agent communication could test coordination beyond text benchmarks. The research question is whether an agent can demonstrate understanding through successful action, not merely a convincing answer. This is a proposed experiment, not a deployed capability.
